The Insurance Act · Trinidad and Tobago “Premiums or other payments due that are received by an agency, brokerage or a sales representative on behalf of an insurer shall be deemed to be received by the insurer notwithstanding any conditions or stipulations to the contrary.” A premium you handed to a registered representative counts as paid to Guardian Life.
